title: {giver}'s lost locket
A keepsake lost
summary: {giver} lost a locket near {target}, {direction} of {settlement}. Find it and bring it back.
offer: I've lost my mother's locket. I think it was by {target}, {direction} of here; I was there gathering, and when I got home it was gone. Would you look?
progress: Did you find it? By {target}, I'm sure of it.
complete: My mother's locket... I thought it was gone forever. Thank you, thank you.
